title: Signing control map
detail: See every direct signing path and test signer-unavailability scenarios without changing the account.

title: Treasury dependency scenarios
detail: Model a shared custodian or device compromise separately from an outage. Owner-supplied assumptions; no signing or changes.

title: Ledger endpoint comparison
detail: Compare AccountRoot bytes at one ledger hash across three endpoints. Agreement is not independent consensus verification.

title: Software advisory exposure
detail: With consent, check exact npm versions against OSV and map advisory identifiers to your workflows. No installed-software discovery or security clearance.

title: Encrypted response notebook
detail: Keep response roles, official contact routes and self-reported drills encrypted on this device. Not a managed key vault; no wallet secrets.

title: Reviewed indicator sharing
detail: Free reviewed-indicator lookups; organization filing needs Institutional access, backend migration and independent participant review. No live network or populated coverage is implied.

title: Account hardening
detail: Inspect master and regular keys, signer quorum, phishing exposure and unsigned hardening proposals.

title: Pre-sign inspection
detail: Explain a proposed transaction before a wallet signs it; flag key changes and dangerous transfers.

title: Destination review
detail: Check a pasted destination against your own address book for lookalikes.

title: Compromise checklist
detail: Review containment options and preserve evidence. No keys, custody or guaranteed recovery.

title: Missing-deposit evidence
detail: Explain a payment and prepare a request for the recipient service, including destination-tag context.

title: Permission exposure
detail: Read standing permissions and owner-reviewed revocation proposals. Batch capacity depends on plan.

title: Domain identity check
detail: Compare the account’s domain claim with the domain’s published account listing. This is not identity certification.

title: Locked-asset review
detail: Find eligible escrows, channels, checks and reserve cleanup opportunities. Different from reversing theft.

title: Control-change comparison
detail: Compare a saved local control snapshot with a fresh validated-ledger reading. Changes require human review.

title: Incident evidence trail
detail: Inspect bounded transfer paths and export a hash dossier. Links are evidence leads, not proof of ownership or recovery.

title: Related-account leads
detail: Review funding and activity similarities. A cluster is a hypothesis, not an attribution of criminal activity.

title: Threat-report review
detail: Lookups are free. Filing organization reports requires Institutional access; reports are not adjudications.

title: Service attribution leads
detail: Inspect service labels and sources; verify the recipient’s official identity before sharing incident evidence.

title: Withdrawal policy review
detail: Screen proposed withdrawals against configured controls before your signing system acts. NOSHASHI does not enforce wallet policy.

title: Market surveillance
detail: Investigate order-book behavior and manipulation indicators; indicators do not prove intent.

title: Reserve evidence
detail: Review supplied liabilities and named ledger accounts. Cannot independently establish control, all liabilities or solvency.

title: Change monitoring
detail: On-device monitoring is free while open; hosted organization monitoring requires contracted Strategic access and configuration.
